target: Seek a certified aggregate-positive but allocation-infeasible block on the grid h,r in {j/16: 1<=j<=32} with unit displacements and unit real-zero budgets.

screen.role: nomination only; no global sign inference

prior_pilot_nomination.role: Earlier numerical-only diagnostic; no exact certificate or sign conclusion
prior_pilot_nomination.sample_bounds: 20001 equally spaced samples in [-5,5], excluding poles
prior_pilot_nomination.sample_thresholds: sample min H>1e-7 and sample min (K_h+real terms)<-1e-4
prior_pilot_nomination.status: All 450 points remained mathematically unresolved by that pilot alone; selected point later certified below

untested_pairs: No exact certificate search after (11,21). The earlier numerical pilot reached (15,2); all later grid pairs were untested even numerically. No mathematical claim about later pairs.

positivity.conclusion: Q(y)>0 for every y>=0; H(x)>0 for every real x!=+/-r

allocation_obstruction.scope: Excludes all four-constant allocations without symmetry reduction; even the h pair cannot use both full unit budgets successfully.

domain.poles: H tends to +infinity at both +/-r; other terms are bounded there
domain.infinity: lim x^2*H(x)=6 as |x| tends to infinity; no uniform positive constant margin is claimed

limitations: Finite first-sign decomposition obstruction only. No Xi realization, infinite assembly, higher signs, or novelty certification. Does not isolate budget competition between individually compensable pairs.
